tasks.title: Extend config schema and accessor for timeout settings
tasks.description: Add `taskTimeout`, `stageTimeout`, and `maxGracePeriods` as optional number fields to the `agent` object in `config-schema.ts`. Add `getAgentTimeoutConfig()` function to `config-loader.ts` that reads these values with defaults (600, 3600, 2). Add zod `.superRefine()` validation on the agent schema for range checks (taskTimeout 60-7200, stageTimeout 300-86400, maxGracePeriods 0-10).
acceptanceCriteria: config-schema.ts agent object includes taskTimeout, stageTimeout, maxGracePeriods as optional number fields
getAgentTimeoutConfig() in config-loader.ts returns { taskTimeout, stageTimeout, maxGracePeriods } with defaults
Zod schema rejects taskTimeout < 60 or > 7200 with descriptive error
Zod schema rejects stageTimeout < 300 or > 86400 with descriptive error
Zod schema rejects maxGracePeriods < 0 or > 10 with descriptive error
Existing config-loader tests still pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the pattern of getServerConfig() and getLogConfig() in config-loader.ts for the new accessor.

tasks.title: Add tests for timeout config schema and accessor
tasks.description: Write tests in config-loader.test.ts covering: explicit values loaded correctly, partial values get defaults, missing agent section returns all defaults, missing file returns all defaults, and all validation rejection cases (negative, too large, non-numeric via schema parse).
acceptanceCriteria: Test: config with explicit taskTimeout/stageTimeout/maxGracePeriods returns those values
Test: config with only taskTimeout returns it + defaults for others
Test: config without agent section returns all defaults
Test: config without file returns all defaults
Test: taskTimeout -100 is rejected by schema parse
Test: taskTimeout 99999 is rejected by schema parse
Test: stageTimeout 200000 is rejected by schema parse
Test: maxGracePeriods -1 is rejected by schema parse
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Add tests to the existing config-loader.test.ts file. Follow its beforeEach/afterEach pattern with tmpDir.

tasks.title: Replace hardcoded timeouts in ralph-executor
tasks.description: In ralph-executor.ts, replace the hardcoded DEFAULT_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS (30min) and MIN_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS (10min) with values from getAgentTimeoutConfig(). The perTaskTimeout calculation should use config.agent.taskTimeout * 1000 as fallback when stageTimeoutMs is not set. Lower MIN_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS to 60s.
acceptanceCriteria: ralph-executor.ts imports and calls getAgentTimeoutConfig() from config-loader
DEFAULT_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS constant is removed, replaced by config.agent.taskTimeout * 1000
MIN_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS is replaced by 60000 (60s) or derived from config minimum
perTaskTimeout calculation: if stageTimeoutMs set → max(stageTimeoutMs/taskCount, 60s), else → taskTimeout*1000
Existing ralph-executor tests still pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The config load happens inside the executeLoop function body (at issue-start time), not at module level. This ensures running issues are unaffected by config changes.

tasks.title: Replace hardcoded stage timeouts in workflow-loader
tasks.description: In workflow-loader.ts, change DEFAULT_WORKFLOW to remove hardcoded timeout values from stages. Modify loadWorkflow to apply config.agent.stageTimeout as default when a stage has no explicit timeout. Workflow YAML timeout values still take precedence.
acceptanceCriteria: workflow-loader.ts imports getAgentTimeoutConfig from config-loader
Stages in DEFAULT_WORKFLOW no longer have hardcoded timeout values (set to undefined or removed)
loadWorkflow applies config.agent.stageTimeout as default for stages without explicit timeout
Workflow YAML explicit timeout values take precedence over config default
Existing workflow-loader tests still pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Be careful: workflow-controller.ts getBuildStageTimeoutMs() calls loadWorkflow() which will now return config-driven defaults. Verify this doesn't break the stage timeout calculation.

tasks.title: Expose timeout config in ConfigService API
tasks.description: Update ConfigService in config-service.ts to include taskTimeout, stageTimeout, and maxGracePeriods in getConfig() response. Read these values from config.jsonc via getAgentTimeoutConfig(). Add validation for these new keys in the validate() method (ranges: taskTimeout 60-7200, stageTimeout 300-86400, maxGracePeriods 0-10). The PUT handler should write to config.jsonc (not SQLite) for these keys.
acceptanceCriteria: getConfig() returns taskTimeout, stageTimeout, maxGracePeriods fields read from config.jsonc
validate() handles 'agent.taskTimeout' key with range 60-7200
validate() handles 'agent.stageTimeout' key with range 300-86400
validate() handles 'agent.maxGracePeriods' key with range 0-10
GET /api/config returns the new timeout fields
PUT /api/config/:key validates and persists the new keys to config.jsonc
Existing config API tests still pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The new timeout keys live in config.jsonc (per design D1), NOT in SQLite. ConfigService.getConfig() should call getAgentTimeoutConfig() from config-loader.ts and merge the result. The Config types in src/types.ts may need updating to include the new fields. The PUT handler should use writeConfig() from config-loader.ts for these keys.
